identity: Nhal Veyr keeps the register of every Throng dead; outside its walls the Debtbound rise to collect debts nobody owes, and a mortuary clerk keeps a ledger of its own.

quests.title: Debts Nobody Owes
quests.text: At night Debtbound Zombies walk the {name:blightfields} {zone_area:blightfields} and knock on doors to collect what they think they are owed. Lay eight of them to rest. Every one of them carries a clerk's stamp; somebody has been registering the dead without telling me.
quests.lesson: The capital's own problem, seeded for the line's climax.

quests.title: Optional: Bowls for the Vigil
quests.text: The Moss-Antler Gaunt Stags graze the {name:blightfields} by day. Bring me eight Raw Meat; the mourners keep vigil for nights on end, and an empty bowl makes for a short vigil.
quests.lesson: A daytime request beside a night hunt.

quests.title: Shelves in the Ledgerstead
quests.text: Sovel Namekeeper at Ossuary Ledgerstead asked for a strong pair of hands; the Gravewood is waking around the archive. Go and see Sovel, and take my regards; Sovel never eats.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the race's heartland.

quests.title: Revenants Collecting Tithes
quests.text: Tithe Revenants stalk the {name:gravefields} {zone_area:gravefields} after dark, demanding a tithe for the dead from the living and from the dead alike. Destroy eight. The stamps they carry all bear one clerk's mark: Hush.
quests.lesson: A night hunt; the Debtbound Zombies there are the minor role.

quests.title: Optional: Pickled, Not Preserved
quests.text: The Tithe Revenants of the {name:gravefields} carry Pickled Flesh. Bring me four. I do not cook it, before you ask; I compare it with my own brine, because someone in this city is pickling the dead without a licence.
quests.lesson: A drop request that shares the revenant outing.

quests.title: Sister Errand: Speargrass Wellhold
quests.text: Our allies need hands as much as we do. Brakka Jarward at Speargrass Wellhold in Speargrass Reach has work for someone who does not tire easily. Go if the grass calls to you; one errand of the three is plenty.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer (one of three): the orc heartland.

quests.title: Sister Errand: Gor Drazhak
quests.text: Thorga Roadspeaker in Gor Drazhak keeps the orcs' roads and complains that nobody walks them. Walk them, then. One errand of the three is plenty.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer (one of three): the orc capital.

quests.title: Sister Errand: Whisperreed Landing
quests.text: Taleko Drycord at Whisperreed Landing in the Whispering Reedlands wants help with the trolls' wet country. Bring a dry pair of boots and go. One errand of the three is plenty.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer (one of three): a troll heartland.

quests.title: The Clerk Who Kept Count
quests.text: {name:mortuary_clerk_hush} keeps a ledger in the {name:tombfields}, {dir_from_giver:mortuary_clerk_hush}, and stamps every dead name into debt. Close the ledger for good: end Hush and destroy four of the Tithe Revenants that rise round the tombs at night.
quests.lesson: The capital line's climax: a named normal leader.

quests.title: To Ashveil Watch
quests.text: The register is closed and the city is in your debt, which is the only debt I accept. The Throng holds Blackwind Rise against the Accord; go to Ashveil Watch and report to Vaska Ashlistener.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the faction's contested zones.

quests.title: Repeatable: Razorback for the Kitchen
quests.text: Plague Razorbacks root through the {name:gravefields} {zone_area:gravefields} by day. Kill six and bring the news; my kitchen takes another order thirty minutes after you hand this one in.
